Recommended Books

Books that have shaped how I think about the work — 41 titles across psychology and contemplative practice. Nothing here is required reading; take what is useful.

Psychology & Consciousness

  • In an Unspoken Voice: How the Body Releases Trauma and Restores Goodness Peter Levine
  • How to Use Herb, Nutrients, and Yoga in Mental Health Richard Brown & Patricia Gerbarg
  • Coming to our Senses: Healing the World Through Mindfulness Jon Kabat-Zinn
  • The Body Keeps the Score: The Brain, Mind and Body in the Healing of Trauma Bessel Van de Kolk
  • How to do the Work: Recognize Your Patterns, Heal from Your Past, & Create Your Self Nicole lePera
  • In the Realm of the Hungry Ghosts: Close Encounters with Addiction Gabor Mate
  • The Healing Power of the Breath: Simple Techniques to Reduce Stress & Anxiety, Enhance Concentration, and Balance Your Emotions Richard Brown & Patricia Gerbarg
  • Man’s Search for Meaning Viktor E. Frankl
  • Psychology and Alchemy C.G. Jung
  • The Way of the Superior Man David Deida
  • Mating in Captivity: Reconciling the Domestic & the Erotic Ether Perel
  • Holotropic Breathwork: A New Approach to Self-Exploration and Therapy Stanislav Grof
  • Beyond Mars and Venus: Relationship Skills for Today's Complex World John Grey
  • Soul Therapy: The Art and Craft of Caring Conversations Thomas Moore
  • I’m Okay Your Okay Thomas Harris
  • Wired for Love: How Understanding Your Partner's Brain and Attachment Style Can Help You Defuse Conflict and Build a Secure Relationship Stan Tatkin
  • Radical Acceptance: Embracing Your Life with the Heart of the Buddha Tara Brach
  • The Wise Heart: A Guide to the Universal Teachings of Buddhist Psychology Jack Kornfield

Spirituality

  • You’re It!: On Hiding, Seeking, and Being Found Alan Watts
  • The Untethered Soul Michael Singer
  • Shambhala: The Sacred Path of the Warrior Chogyam Trungpa Rinpoche

  • Invisible Acts of Power Caroline Myss
  • Kosmic Consciousness Ken Wilber
  • The Path to No Self Bernadette Roberts
  • On Having no Head Douglas Harding
  • Kundalini Tantra Swami Satchananda Saraswati
  • Be Here Now Ram Dass
  • Becoming Supernatural Joe Dispenza
  • The Phenomenon of Man Pierre Teilhard de Chardin

  • Many Lives Many Masters Brian Weisse
